name: alpha_selection
notes: Chooses the Tikhonov strength alpha on a VALIDATION ensemble (validation_seed 44, noise seed 9000) using only alpha-independent layouts (random layouts with layout_seed 77 + spread; not greedy). Criterion: mean regional RMSE over budgets, layouts, cases and noise reps, uniform weights; lowest wins, exact tie -> smaller alpha. Independent of every test scenario. Prior mean is zero; q_scale 1e5 ug/s, so only alpha/q_scale^2 matters.
